metadata.name: Schedule Trigger
metadata.summary: Start a Greentic flow on a cron schedule
metadata.description: Ships the schedule trigger nodeType (trigger contract v1: greentic-start's scheduler fires the flow when a cron expression comes due and enters it at the node after the trigger) plus three design-time tools (validate_cron, describe_schedule, suggest_cron). The schedule is parsed with the same crate the runtime schedules with, so an expression this extension accepts is one the deploy accepts.

nodeTypes.label: Schedule Trigger
nodeTypes.config_schema: {"type":"object","x-trigger-kind":"cron","required":["expr"],"properties":{"expr":{"type":"string","description":"Cron expression: 5 fields (minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5) or 6 with a leading seconds field. Checked with the same parser the runtime schedules with."},"timezone":{"type":"string","description":"IANA zone the expression is read in, e.g. Asia/Jakarta. Absent means UTC — set it whenever the time was meant as local wall-clock time."},"trigger_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$","description":"Stable id for this trigger. Defaults to the node id; set it to keep the id when the node is renamed."},"enabled":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"description":"false keeps the schedule declared but fires nothing (kill switch)."},"session":{"type":"object","description":"How firings are grouped into conversations.","properties":{"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["per_run","per_key"],"default":"per_run"},"key":{"type":"string","description":"For per_key: a fixed key shared by every firing of this schedule."}}},"limits":{"type":"object","properties":{"max_concurrency":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":1,"description":"Firings allowed to run at once. 1 means a slow run delays the next tick rather than overlapping it."},"max_firings_per_hour":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}}}}}

tools.name: validate_cron
tools.description: Validate a schedule trigger config block (trigger contract v1 shape: expr and timezone at the top level) and return diagnostics: expr is required and is parsed exactly as the runtime parses it, timezone must be an IANA zone name, a nested cron object or a legacy field is named with the fix.

tools.name: describe_schedule
tools.description: Describe a cron expression in words and list its next five fire times in the declared zone. The prose is best effort and says so when it cannot describe an expression; the fire times are always exact.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"expr":{"type":"string","description":"The cron expression to describe."},"timezone":{"type":"string","description":"IANA zone the expression is read in; absent means UTC."},"from":{"type":"string","description":"RFC 3339 instant to count the next fire times from; absent means now."}},"required":["expr"]}

tools.name: suggest_cron
tools.description: Turn a phrase such as 'every weekday at 9am Jakarta time' into a cron expression and an IANA zone. Abstains with a reason when the phrasing is not recognised rather than guessing a schedule.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","description":"A phrase such as 'every weekday at 9am Jakarta time'."},"timezone":{"type":"string","description":"IANA zone; wins over any zone named in the text."}},"required":["text"]}
